race.description: Ladbrokes Turn On Flex Multi (Bm68) Hcp
race.comment: LEBANESE (7) is in great touch after leading all of the way here last time. No tougher this time and she only has to hold her form despite lugging more weight. KOKATAHI (10) has been beaten narrowly in two runs back, and while he's drawn out he should be hitting his straps third-up. DON'T DOUBT MISSY (17) is her own worse enemy, continually leaving herself with too much ground to bridge after slow starts. Blinkers go on first time in the hopes of having her sharper away. If she takes closer order she can play a major role late. Not dismissing. ED I AM (20) has progressed nicely this campaign and faces comes in fresh. Has posted all three wins over this trip, so worth keeping in mind.
